```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(DiagrammeR)

library(here)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,

)

figure_output_dir <- here::here("fig_s2_files")
dir.create(figure_output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

## PubMed search

The figure used in the publication is a manually formatted version of the figure generated by this code; the two versions differ only in visual presentation, not in information content.

```{r pubmed_search}
pubmed_query <- paste(
  '(
    "Lyme Disease"[MeSH]
    AND "Humans"[MeSH]
    AND (
      "CCL19 protein, human"[nm]
      OR "Biomarkers"[MeSH]
      OR "Proteomics"[MeSH]
      OR "Metabolomics"[MeSH]
      OR "Chromatography, Liquid"[MeSH]
      OR "Transcriptome"[MeSH]
      OR "Gene Expression Profiling"[MeSH]
    )
    AND English[lang]
    AND ("2000/01/01"[PDAT] : "2025/12/31"[PDAT])
  )
  OR
  (
    "Lyme disease"[ti]
    AND "diagnostic classifier"[ti]
  )
  NOT (
    "Review"[Publication Type]
    OR "Case Reports"[Publication Type]
    OR "Comment"[Publication Type]
    OR "Lyme Disease/cerebrospinal fluid"[MeSH]
    OR "Lyme Neuroborreliosis"[MeSH]
    OR "Disease Models, Animal"[MeSH]
    OR "Peromyscus/microbiology"[MAJR]
    OR "Biomarkers/urine"[MeSH]
    OR "Urinalysis"[MeSH]
    OR "Serologic Tests"[MeSH]
    OR "Antibodies, Bacterial"[MeSH]
    OR "Antigens, Bacterial"[MeSH]
    OR "Bacterial Proteins"[MeSH]
    OR "Gene Expression Regulation, Bacterial"[MeSH]
    OR "Synovial Membrane"[MeSH]
    OR "Ixodes"[MeSH]
    OR "Astrocytes"[MeSH]
    OR "Microglia"[MeSH]
    OR "Fibroblasts"[MeSH]
    OR "Cells, Cultured"[MeSH]
    OR "Mice"[MeSH]
    OR "Microscopy, Fluorescence"[MeSH]
    OR "Drug Resistance, Bacterial"[MeSH]
    OR "HLA-DR Antigens"[MeSH]
    OR "CD4 Antigens"[MeSH]
    OR "CD57 Antigens"[MeSH]
    OR "Antigens, CD"[MeSH]
    OR "Multiple Sclerosis"[MeSH]
    OR "Multilocus Sequence Typing"[MeSH]
    OR "Polymorphism, Restriction Fragment Length"[MeSH]
    OR "Monocytes"[MeSH]
    OR "Fluorescent Antibody Technique"[MeSH]
    OR "RNA, Bacterial"[nm]
    OR "Food Hypersensitivity"[MeSH]
    OR "Microbiota"[MeSH]
    OR "Gallic Acid"[MeSH]
    OR "Infant"[MeSH]
    OR "Epitope Mapping"[MeSH]
  )'
)

entrez_key <- Sys.getenv("ENTREZ_KEY", unset = "")
if (nzchar(entrez_key)) {
  rentrez::set_entrez_key(entrez_key)
}

pubmed_result <- NULL
for (attempt in seq_len(4)) {
  pubmed_result <- tryCatch(
    rentrez::entrez_search(
      db = "pubmed",
      term = pubmed_query,
      retmax = 10000
    ),
    error = function(error) {
      if (attempt == 4 || !grepl("429|rate limit", conditionMessage(error))) {
        stop(error)
      }
      Sys.sleep(4 * attempt)
      NULL
    }
  )

  if (!is.null(pubmed_result)) {
    break
  }
}

identified_pmids <- unique(pubmed_result$ids)
```

## Screening decisions

```{r screening_decisions}
title_abstract_exclusions <- tibble::tribble(
  ~pmid,       ~reason,
  "11121150",  "Not a transcriptomic study",
  "35414496",  "Single-target Troponin T study",
  "27695100",  "Ex vivo cell-movement focus",
  "29542338",  "Review article",
  "31314581",  "Statistical or methods focus",
  "41460915",  "Borrelia lipidomics without host omics",
  "41171455",  "Machine-learning reanalysis of existing data only",
  "41013556",  "Machine-learning reanalysis of existing data only"
)

full_text_exclusions <- tibble::tribble(
  ~pmid,       ~reason,
  "28172519",  "No confirmed Lyme disease cohort",
  "35457192",  "TBE-focused cohort; Lyme disease only as a co-infection"
)

benchmark_studies <- tibble::tribble(
  ~modality,       ~study,       ~pmid,
  "Metabolomics",  "Molins",     "25761869",
  "Metabolomics",  "Fitzgerald", "32975577",
  "Metabolomics",  "Kehoe",      "35087163",
  "Proteomics",    "Soloski",    "24740099",
  "Proteomics",    "Aucott",     "27358211",
  "Proteomics",    "Zhou",       "31618575"
)

duplicate_pmids <- character()
not_retrieved_pmids <- character()

excluded_pmids <- c(
  title_abstract_exclusions$pmid,
  full_text_exclusions$pmid
)

if (!all(excluded_pmids %in% identified_pmids)) {
  stop(
    "The PubMed search did not return screened PMID(s): ",
    paste(setdiff(excluded_pmids, identified_pmids), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

included_pmids <- setdiff(
  identified_pmids,
  c(duplicate_pmids, not_retrieved_pmids, excluded_pmids)
)

stopifnot(
  length(identified_pmids) == 31L,
  nrow(title_abstract_exclusions) == 8L,
  nrow(full_text_exclusions) == 2L,
  length(included_pmids) == 21L,
  all(benchmark_studies$pmid %in% included_pmids)
)
```

## Figure S2

```{r figure_s2}
graphviz_lines <- function(x) {
  paste(x, collapse = "\\n")
}

title_exclusion_lines <- paste0(
  title_abstract_exclusions$reason,
  " [",
  title_abstract_exclusions$pmid,
  "]"
)

full_text_exclusion_lines <- paste0(
  full_text_exclusions$reason,
  " [",
  full_text_exclusions$pmid,
  "]"
)

metabolomic_panels <- benchmark_studies |>
  dplyr::filter(modality == "Metabolomics") |>
  dplyr::transmute(label = paste0(study, " [", pmid, "]")) |>
  dplyr::pull(label)

proteomic_panels <- benchmark_studies |>
  dplyr::filter(modality == "Proteomics") |>
  dplyr::transmute(label = paste0(study, " [", pmid, "]")) |>
  dplyr::pull(label)

diagram_source <- sprintf(
  "
digraph prisma {
  graph [
    layout = dot,
    rankdir = TB,
    fontname = Arial,
    nodesep = 0.25,
    ranksep = 0.45,
    splines = ortho
  ]

  node [
    shape = box,
    fontname = Arial,
    fontsize = 13,
    width = 3.2,
    margin = 0.12
  ]

  edge [
    arrowsize = 0.7,
    color = black
  ]

  A [label = 'Records identified from PubMed\\n(n = %d)']
  B [label = 'Duplicates removed\\n(n = %d)']
  C [label = 'Records screened (title/abstract)\\n(n = %d)']
  D [label = 'Records excluded\\n(n = %d)']
  E [label = 'Reports sought for retrieval\\n(n = %d)']
  F [label = 'Reports not retrieved\\n(n = %d)']
  G [label = 'Reports assessed for eligibility\\n(n = %d)']
  H [label = 'Reports excluded\\n(n = %d)']
  I [label = 'Studies included in study inventory\\n(n = %d)', penwidth = 2]

  A -> C -> E -> G -> I
  A -> B
  C -> D
  E -> F
  G -> H

  {rank=same; A; B}
  {rank=same; C; D}
  {rank=same; E; F}
  {rank=same; G; H}

  node [
    shape = box,
    style = 'rounded,dashed,filled',
    fillcolor = 'gray97',
    fontsize = 11,
    width = 4.6
  ]

  Search [label =
    'Search strategy (PubMed; 31 December 2025)\\n\\nInclusion:\\nHuman Lyme disease studies\\nHost omics or biomarker studies\\nDiagnostic-classifier studies identified by title terms\\nEnglish-language articles (2000-2025)\\n\\nExclusion:\\nReviews, case reports, and comments\\nAnimal models\\nCSF-, urine-, or serology-only studies\\nBorrelia-only omics'
  ]

  TitleReasons [label =
    'Excluded at title/abstract screening (n = %d)\\n\\n%s'
  ]

  FullTextReasons [label =
    'Excluded after full-text review (n = %d)\\n\\n%s'
  ]

  Panels [label =
    'Studies contributing benchmarking panels\\n\\nMetabolomics panels:\\n%s\\n\\nProteomic panels:\\n%s'
  ]

  {rank=same; Search; A}
  {rank=same; D; TitleReasons}
  {rank=same; H; FullTextReasons}
  {rank=same; I; Panels}

  node [
    shape = plain,
    style = '',
    fillcolor = white,
    fontsize = 10,
    width = 0
  ]

  Footnote [label =
    'Note: The publication figure was manually formatted from this code-generated diagram.\\nFlow counts and exclusion reasons are identical; only visual presentation differs.'
  ]

  I -> Footnote [style=invis, arrowhead=none]

  edge [style=dashed, arrowhead=none, constraint=false, color=gray40]
  Search -> A
  D -> TitleReasons
  H -> FullTextReasons
  I -> Panels
}
  ",
  length(identified_pmids),
  length(duplicate_pmids),
  length(identified_pmids) - length(duplicate_pmids),
  nrow(title_abstract_exclusions),
  length(identified_pmids) -
    length(duplicate_pmids) -
    nrow(title_abstract_exclusions),
  length(not_retrieved_pmids),
  length(identified_pmids) -
    length(duplicate_pmids) -
    nrow(title_abstract_exclusions) -
    length(not_retrieved_pmids),
  nrow(full_text_exclusions),
  length(included_pmids),
  nrow(title_abstract_exclusions),
  graphviz_lines(title_exclusion_lines),
  nrow(full_text_exclusions),
  graphviz_lines(full_text_exclusion_lines),
  graphviz_lines(metabolomic_panels),
  graphviz_lines(proteomic_panels)
)

prisma_diagram <- DiagrammeR::grViz(diagram_source)

svg_text <- DiagrammeRsvg::export_svg(prisma_diagram)

figureS2 <- here::here("fig_s2_files", "figure_S02_literature_review_prisma_diagram.png")

rsvg::rsvg_png(
  charToRaw(svg_text),
  file = figureS2,
  width = 3900,
  height = 2400
)

knitr::include_graphics(figureS2)
```
